scenario.topic: Pick a backup service for a small photography business

options.name: Backblaze Personal Backup
options.upside: Offers unlimited storage with continuous automatic backups.
options.concern: No native file sharing or collaboration features.

options.name: Google Drive for Business
options.upside: Includes file sharing and collaboration tools integrated with Google Workspace.
options.concern: Scheduled backups require manual setup and management.

options.name: Dropbox Plus
options.upside: Supports continuous backup with easy file recovery and sharing.
options.concern: Limited to 2TB storage which may fill quickly with large photo files.

options.name: Amazon S3 Standard Storage

attrs.backup_type: manual or automated via third-party tools

options.concern: Requires technical setup and management for automated backups.

shared_context: A small photography business needs a reliable backup service to store and protect image files. The service must support at least 2TB of storage, offer automated backups, and provide easy file recovery options.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya manages the business operations of a small photography studio focused on client satisfaction.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the backup service integrates well with collaboration tools to streamline workflow.

A.reason_for: Unlimited storage and continuous backup provide strong data protection.
A.reason_against: Lacks collaboration features important for team workflow.

B.reason_for: Includes file sharing and collaboration integrated with Google Workspace, fitting business needs.

C.reason_for: Continuous backup and easy file sharing are useful for quick access and recovery.
C.reason_against: Storage limit of 2TB might be restrictive as photo files accumulate.

D.reason_for: Highly scalable and secure storage could be beneficial long term.
D.reason_against: Requires technical setup and management, which is impractical for current team skills.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is the lead photographer who prioritizes ease of use and reliable file recovery.
personas.private_goal: Find a backup solution that requires minimal setup and supports continuous backups.

A.reason_for: Unlimited storage and continuous automatic backups reduce manual effort.
A.reason_against: No native sharing features limit collaboration possibilities.

B.reason_for: Good collaboration tools and 2TB storage meet basic needs.
B.reason_against: Scheduled backups need manual management, which is inconvenient.

C.reason_for: Continuous backup with easy file recovery and sharing fits his workflow perfectly.

D.reason_for: Scalable and secure storage is attractive for future growth.
D.reason_against: Technical setup and management are barriers for ease of use.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe handles IT and data security for the photography business, focusing on reliability and cost-efficiency.
personas.private_goal: Choose a cost-effective backup with unlimited or scalable storage and automated backups.

A.reason_for: Unlimited storage with continuous automatic backups ensures data safety and cost predictability.

B.reason_for: Collaboration tools are useful but less important than backup reliability and cost.
B.reason_against: Limited to 2TB and scheduled backups require manual setup.

C.reason_for: Continuous backup and sharing are positives, but 2TB limit and cost are concerns.
C.reason_against: Storage may be insufficient for large photo archives.

D.reason_for: Highly scalable and secure with pay-as-you-go pricing suits long-term needs.
D.reason_against: Requires technical setup, but Zoe is comfortable managing this complexity.
